name.label: Name
name.hint: Used as identifier (lowercase, e.g. mobile, erp-v2)

module.published: The system publishes its modules from its code (last time: {{date}}). To add or remove modules or actions, change them in the system: anything edited here would be lost on its next publication.

detail.confirmDeleteDescription: You are about to permanently delete this system. Roles assigned to this system will lose their system reference. This action cannot be undone.

new.title: New External System
new.nameAlreadyUsed: A system with this name already exists

update.title: Edit External System
update.nameAlreadyUsed: A system with this name already exists

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Use this key to authenticate requests from your external system. Send it in the X-Api-Key header.
apiKey.rotateHint: Rotating the key invalidates the previous one. Update your external system with the new key.
apiKey.confirmRotateDescription: The previous key will stop working immediately. You will need to update your external system with the new key.

oauth.title: OIDC connection (single sign-on)
oauth.description: How this system signs users in with the identity center. Its access tokens are JWTs with its API URL as audience.

resourceIdentifier.label: System API URL
resourceIdentifier.helper: Sent as "aud" in the tokens: the system must check it matches.

redirectUris.label: Redirect URLs
redirectUris.helper: One per line. https in production; http only on localhost (development).

clientType.label: Client type
clientType.helper: Public for browser apps; confidential when a server handles the login.
clientType.locked: The type cannot change once the client exists.

oauth.saveError: The OIDC connection could not be saved
oauth.resourceInUse: Another system already uses this API URL
oauth.secretWarning: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.

service.title: Service credentials
service.description: Lets the system's backend call the identity center's external API (permissions, catalog) with the standard OAuth client_credentials grant, instead of the API key.
service.rotateConfirmDescription: A new client ID and secret are created. The current ones stop working right away: update the system's backend.
service.error: The credentials could not be created
